definitions: To make a movement of the body or a part of it, especially a hand or the head, to express an idea or meaning, without full conscious attention or awareness.
To make a gesture in a preoccupied or distracted manner.
examples: She would absently gesture towards the window while lost in thought.
He began to absently gesture with his hands as he explained the complex problem.
The professor would often absently gesture with his chalk during lectures.
